name: janus-faers-onset-pipc
title: FAERS time to onset for the 65 PIPC prescribing cascades (descriptive)
description: For every PIPC row (drug A class -> adverse event): FAERS reports with a class member as suspect and the event, how many carry a usable interval and why the others do not, and the reported time to onset (median, quartiles, intervals, Weibull shape) where the data allow it. Descriptive, not causal, not incidence; counts are reports, not people. Janus provides information, not medical advice. Research prototype — not a medical device.

sources.title: Rochon PA et al. PIPC list. Eur Geriatr Med 2025;16(5):1573-1584, Table 1 (CC BY 4.0)
FDA Adverse Event Reporting System quarterly data files (CC0 1.0); not an FDA endorsement
Janus curation (Apache-2.0): data/onset_key_exclusions.csv, data/onset_row_notes.csv, data/cascade_classes.csv, data/pipc_rules.csv
